Prepare the CTAB Buffer Lysis Solution (500 mL) Reagents needed: CTAB (Cetyltrimethylammonium bromide) Tris-HCl (pH 8) EDTA (disodium salt, pH 8) NaCl Sodium sulfite (Na₂SO₃) Distilled water Exact amounts for 500 mL: CTAB: 10 g (2% w/v) Tris-HCl: 6.06 g (100 mM) EDTA: 0.372 g (20 mM) NaCl: 40.9 g (1.4 M) Na₂SO₃: 3.16 g (80 mM) Procedure: Dissolve CTAB: In a 1 L beaker, add ~400 mL of distilled water and slowly dissolve 10 g of CTAB with gentle stirring. Add Tris-HCl: Add 6.06 g of Tris-HCl and stir until completely dissolved. Ensure the pH is around 8.0. Add EDTA: Add 0.372 g of EDTA (pH 8) and mix thoroughly. Add NaCl: Dissolve 40.9 g of NaCl into the solution with continuous stirring. Add Sodium Sulfite: Add 3.16 g of Na₂SO₃ and mix until fully dissolved. Adjust Volume: Bring the total volume up to 500 mL with distilled water. Mix and Store: Stir the solution until completely homogeneous. Store the buffer at room temperature or 4°C as appropriate. NOTE: Use freshly activated buffer for experiments by adding 5% polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP-10) and 2% v/v β-mercaptoethanol. Pre-warm at 65 °C before use.

steps.title: Prepare leaf sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 2 g of leaf material, grind to a fine powder in liquid nitrogen with a mortar and pestle, and transfer the powder to a 50 mL Falcon® (polypropylene) conical tube.

steps.title: CTAB lysis of ground tissue
steps.instruction: Add 8 mL pre‑warmed, activated CTAB buffer to the ground tissue, vortex thoroughly, incubate at 65 °C for 30 min, mix by inversion, then incubate a further 30 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: Chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 8 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the lysate, mix by inversion, centrifuge at 6,000 × g for 12 min at room temperature, and transfer the supernatant to a new 50 mL Falcon® tube.

steps.title: RNase treatment to remove RNA
steps.instruction: Add 5 µg DNase‑free RNase to the supernatant and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform purification
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), vortex thoroughly, centrifuge at 6,000 × g for 12 min, then transfer the supernatant to a clean tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation and ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol (propan‑2‑ol) to the supernatant, incubate at –20 °C for 1 h, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 min, discard the supernatant, wash the pellet twice with two volumes of 70 % ethanol (repeat wash), and finally resuspend the DNA in DNase/RNase‑free deionized water or low‑TE buffer.

steps.title: SPRI bead inhibitor removal and DNA elution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Sera‑Mag‱ SpeedBeads/AMPure XP beads to 50 µL DNA extract (2× bead cleanup), pipette up/down five times, incubate at room temperature for 10 min, briefly spin down, place on a magnetic rack for 3 min (or until a pellet forms), remove and discard the supernatant while on the magnet, wash beads twice with 100 µL 80 % ethanol (stand 1 min each wash and remove ethanol), keep beads on the magnet and dry with caps open at room temperature for ~3 min (avoid overdrying), remove from magnet, add 30 µL purified/distilled water (or an equal volume of the original extract) – optionally add a smaller volume of water to concentrate – cover, vortex and spin down, incubate at room temperature for 5 min to elute DNA, place back on the magnet until the solution is clear, transfer 30 µL clear supernatant to a new tube, and proceed to DNA qualification and quantification.

steps.title: Store purified DNA
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA at 2 °C–8 °C for 1–2 weeks or at –15 °C to –25 °C for longer term storage.
